summary: Iteration 3 full-stack testing: multi-item pickups, custom scrap types, pickup OTP + COD service fee completion, Razorpay disabled state, head/district admin scoping, and the shadcn Select/DatePicker migration. Backend: 66/67 pytest pass across 3 suites (iter1/iter2 suites updated to the items[] + otp API). Frontend: all requested flows pass in the UI at 1920px and 390px. 1 real bug found: the admin assign endpoint returns the customer's OTP.

critical.issue: The response returns the raw pickup document, including the customer's 'otp'. This breaks the rule that the OTP is never returned to admin, delivery or partner APIs. Fix: return strip_otp(await db.pickups.find_one(...), user) (server.py line ~781).

minor.issue: Unverified or admin_assign-mode delivery partners now get 404 instead of the more helpful 403 ('Complete your verification...' / 'assigned by admin'). can_view_pickup hides the pool before the 403 checks run. Access is still blocked correctly; iter2 tests now accept 403 or 404.

If the admin completes a COD pickup without ticking cash collected, payment_status stays 'pending' forever, so a Completed order keeps showing '₹25 Due'. own_online_pickup would also allow a Razorpay order for an already-completed pickup. Consider marking these 'waived', or blocking payment on Completed pickups.

On a fresh DB the items/otp migration runs BEFORE SAMPLE_PICKUPS are inserted. Sample pickups then have no otp until the next restart, so a delivery partner can never complete them (the otp comparison is against None). Move the migration after the sample insert, or add items/otp/payment fields in the sample docs.

issues: Subtitle still says 'across Tamil Nadu' for a district-scoped admin. Cosmetic.

design_issues.screen: Desktop My Pickups / All Pickups tables
issues: At 1920px the table needs a horizontal scroll (the Date/Action columns are cut off). Acceptable, but these columns could be condensed.

action_items: Wrap the /scrap/pickups/{id}/assign response in strip_otp so the customer OTP is not leaked to admins
(minor) Handle payment_status when an admin completes a COD pickup without cash collected
(minor) Fix seed ordering so fresh-DB sample pickups get an otp, items and payment fields
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1007 lines; split it into routers (auth, pickups, zones, admin, payments, kyc, files)
update_user allows admin_scope on non-admin users (validated only against districts). Harmless but untidy.
Settings rate keys are arbitrary user strings stored as Mongo field names. Names containing '.' or starting with '$' could break the doc; validate the scrap type name charset.

Playbook: bcrypt $2b$ OK; brute-force lockout after 5 fails is implemented; seed resets the password unless password_changed. Auth uses a Bearer token (no httpOnly cookies) and CORS is '*' with allow_credentials=False, which is consistent for header auth.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. TEST_ pickups/users/zones were removed. Settings were restored to 4 types at 12/18/45/35, service_fee 25, dispatch open. test32 KYC is verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the suites serially: pytest /app/backend/tests -n 0 (all 3 files). The iter3 file uses the module-scoped dict S and cleans TEST* pickups/zones and the test_iter3_madurai user in teardown. Pickup create now needs items:[{material,weight,unit}]. Delivery Completed needs otp (read it from the customer's GET /scrap/pickups/{id}) plus cash_collected when payment_status is pending. The UiSelect option testid is {testId}-option-{slug(value)} (e.g. login-role-select-option-delivery-partner). Verified in the UI: sell multi-item (₹650 for 10/5/2 kg + 0.01 t), My Pickups OTP + timeline-otp, delivery accept→in progress→complete dialog (wrong OTP / no cash rejected), admin complete without OTP, settings add/remove TEST_Glass and service fee, user scope selects, district-admin zones locked to Madurai, 390px layouts. To recheck after the fix: test_assign_endpoint_does_not_leak_otp.
